summary: Public procurement planning and framework agreements training for practical tender design, evaluation, and call-off control. Enquire now.
lede: Public procurement planning and framework agreement training covers turning demand into sourcing plans and workable agreements. For procurement officers, category managers, tender specialists and contract administrators, it builds practical skills in needs and spend analysis, framework design, tender evaluation and call-off tracking, helping them prepare and manage procurement documents from defining requirements through framework use.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already work with procurement documents and want stronger capability in planning, framework setup, and controlled award decisions.
prerequisites: You should bring a working laptop, basic spreadsheet skills, and familiarity with procurement or contract documentation. If possible, prepare one sample procurement plan, tender file, framework schedule, or spend report from your current role for workshop use.
